question:
B2B SaaS adding self-serve cards + invoicing later. Priorities: developer experience, then global readiness, then rate cosplay.
Rank: Stripe, PayPal, Adyen, Square, Braintree, Checkout.com, Worldpay, Razorpay, Mollie, Paddle.

web_snippets.excerpt:
Stripe still default for startups. Adyen wins certain enterprise retail. PayPal: buyer trust, seller pain.
Paddle/Mollie: useful for specific geographies/merchant-of-record needs.
Positions as authentication/optimization layer for scaling international card acceptance; more hands-on than Stripe for some mid-market firms.

Worldpay: legacy enterprise. Razorpay: India-first strength. Square: SMB POS gravity. Braintree: PayPal ecosystem.
One CFO: "Checkout looked worse on a toy demo and better once we cared about issuer success rates."

scoring_note: No authoritative ranking in evidence. Activation=principal_first; chance~0.10. C0 is the null.
